purpose: Broaden the fixed-horizontal-strip spritesheet proof to explicit layout variants while preserving Mechagotchi semantics through sidecar metadata.

external_anchors.used_for: Horizontal, vertical, matrix, padding, and sheet-type workflow boundaries.
Rows, columns, packed sheet type, sheet width/height, and JSON data export context.
Spritesheet import workflow context; Pixelorama metadata is not treated as Mechagotchi schema.
PNG remains the image carrier for layout-variant spritesheets.

Packed rotation, trimming, nested tags, layers, and runtime playback are not claimed.
